content.short: Spectral Finance is a credit scoring tool that promotes on-chain capital efficiency.
content.description: Spectral Finance, established in 2020 by Sishir Varghese, employs a Multi-Asset Credit Risk Oracle (Macro Score) to create a programmable creditworthiness ecosystem. Through credit risk analysis across multiple assets, Spectral aims to increase capital efficiency on-chain. It also issues non-fungible creditor NFTs (NFCs) that bundle wallets into a single composable asset by syncing users' complete on-chain transactional history.
content.meta: Spectral Finance uses a Multi-Asset Credit Risk Oracle to power credit scoring. Discover Spectral Finance and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
